articles.title: NASA's Lucy Spies a Wobbly, Peanut-Shaped Asteroid with a Watery Past
articles.summary: The asteroid Donaldjohanson is a wobbly, bilobate rock that once held liquid water. Lucy's flyby revealed a complex rotation and a surprisingly young age of 155 million years. This practice run sets the stage for exploring Jupiter's Trojans.

articles.title: The Hidden Language of Cross-Species Cooperation
articles.summary: A new review reveals how animals use specialized signals to coordinate across species. From honeyguide birds leading humans to bees' nests to cleaner fish advertising their services, communication is key to these mutualistic partnerships.

articles.title: Cracking Wordle: How Information Theory Wins 99% of the Time
articles.summary: Binghamton University researchers have developed a Wordle strategy using Shannon entropy that achieves a 99% success rate. By prioritizing informative guesses over likely answers, the method dramatically narrows possibilities.
